thread:
anya: Heads-up — noticed the Console 'Cost by model' widget disappeared after the last presets migration. The docs example still points to `presets/cost/model.yaml` and that URL 404s. Anyone else?
samir: Saw it in Playground too. Short-term we can patch the link. Longer-term we need a migration note.
felix: I opened a quick PR to fix the path + add a note about the schema change: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9812
anya: Great. Can you also add a minimal SDK snippet (Python) showing how to attach trace keys for cost attribution? The tracing-hook page lacks a compact example.
felix: Planning to add a tiny Python example and a jq mapping one-liner for log migration. I'll push to the PR.
jenna: FYI runtime renamed the trace key from `trace_id` -> `trace_hex` in v2. Docs should include a migration section and a safe mapping example.
samir: Suggest including a CLI one-liner to rewrite exported event logs for ops: e.g. `jq '.events |= map(if .trace_id then .trace_hex = (.trace_id | ltrimstr("0x")) | del(.trace_id) else . end)'` — needs testing.
anya: Nice start. Prefer preserving nulls and unexpected shapes; add a short Node snippet too. Also make sure the SDK snippet uses the official helper API (e.g., `redwood.tracing.attach_trace_hex(...)`).
felix: Pushed commit: added Python snippet, the jq one-liner, and a migration anchor. Left TODOs for Node/Rust examples.
docs-bot: lint/links-checker started for PR #9812
jenna: There's also a broken internal link on the tracing-hook page pointing to `/api/v1/telemetry` (deprecated). Update examples to `/telemetry/v2` and mention the redirect.
samir: I'll append the link fix to the PR and add a redirect note for infra.
anya: Let's avoid doc bloat — make the migration guidance an anchor `#v2-migration` and add a single-line changelog entry. We'll backfill detailed examples later via follow-ups.
felix: Added `#v2-migration` anchor + changelog note. docs-bot reports 1 failing example render.
docs-bot: example-sniffer job failed on `console-presets-snippet` — missing `presets` frontmatter in the markdown.
felix: Fixing frontmatter now (adding `presets: true` and `render: inline`).
jenna: Ping me when CI is green — I'll do a quick tech accuracy pass. :eyes: 
samir: Also flagged: screenshot alt text missing for the dashboard widget — accessibility checker recommended adding alt text describing the chart.
anya: Checklist for PR 9812: 1) link fixes, 2) Python SDK snippet, 3) jq mapping example, 4) `#v2-migration` anchor + changelog entry, 5) screenshot alt text, 6) example tests passing.
felix: Done all of the above and pushed. CI is green, merging now. :tada:
docs-bot: PR #9812 merged by felix — all checks passed.
jenna: Can we file a follow-up issue to add Node + Rust snippets and an automated eval to verify cost attribution after migration?
anya: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/4026 and assigned to samir + felix.
samir: I'll take the Node snippet, felix will do Rust. Closing thread.
